Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 12 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 41 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aarav writes in his notebook.]

Aarav: "Exactly right."

[Aarav studies for his exam.]

Aarav (laughing): "Okay, Mom."

[Aarav does his homework at the table.]

Aarav (surprised): "Really?"

[Aarav's phone rings and he answers it.]

Aarav: "That's great!"

[Aarav types on his laptop.]

Meenakshi: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Aarav watches cartoons on TV.]

Aarav: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Aarav: "So, here we are!"

[Aarav walks across the courtyard.]

Aarav (gently): "Hey, look at that!"

[Aarav runs to Mother.]

Aarav: "Show me too!"

[Aarav tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Meenakshi: "Really?"

[Aarav climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Meenakshi: "Listen!"

[Aarav hides behind the tree.]

Aarav: "Mom, listen!"

[Aarav searches for his lost ball.]

Aarav: "Okay, Mom."

[Aarav peeks out from behind the door.]

Aarav (surprised): "That's great!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Thick fog lies all around. Aarav stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Aarav: "Let's begin."

[The mist slowly clears.]

Meenakshi (excited): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
